replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I don't see why I would give you my server IP and let you on.

You don't provide any examples (like pictures) of your previous builds. The only was to determine your skill level would be your "rating" which you said is 8/10 but your 8/10 might be my 2/10 so no real was of seeing how good you are.

"who ever joins the persons ip will temporily be banned" - Even if I would let you on my server that doesn't mean I would give you permission to ban people. I would just give you a world to build on not give you full OP permission.

Sorry but from what you have written, I would be surprised if anyone would let you on their server unless they let a lot of people on.
